«وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» has no transmitter and the Imam is unnamed: the speaker is inherited from prev1 («وَقَالَ اَلصَّادِقُ»)
«وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» has no transmitter: the Imam is unnamed here, so the Imam that report 910 names as speaker is taken over (owner ruling; rule 10). The Imam is the last link.
The saying has no further route.
